title: narumi ensemble target, execution origin and safe error provenance
$comment: Draft public target/origin/error shapes. Artifact generation observations and publication lineage are defined separately in processing_artifacts.json.

processing_target_ref.description: The run/node/call currently inspected or confirmed by the caller. This is not a historical execution-origin reference.

processing_origin_ref.description: Historical execution identity and non-secret authorization provenance from the saved attempt. Preserve its original run, connection revision and model when a later run reuses or inspects that attempt. Never rewrite it to the current selection.

processing_current_selection.description: Current planned selection for the target node, distinct from historical origin. It is a display projection, not a substitute for full ModelSelection/config authorization checks.

processing_retry_lineage.description: Closed confirmed-retry ancestry. attempt_chain[0].attempt equals origin_unknown and has outcome=unknown; attempt IDs are unique and ordered by retry_of ancestry. resolved_by is null unless the final chain item succeeded, and otherwise equals that final attempt. These cross-field rules are enforced by typed/server validation. A retry may use a different connection, but the original unknown and every intermediate origin remain unchanged. maxItems=64 is the lifetime limit for this same content-unknown barrier, separate from each run's 64-attempt budget. Reject attempt 65 without consuming proof, reserving run budget or sending; preserve the existing unknown and chain.

processing_safe_error.description: Closed error assembled from trusted local code and bounded public messages. Never include upstream bodies, arbitrary provider diagnostics, secrets, raw requests or paths.

retry_attempts_used.description: Lifetime attempts already recorded for this same content-unknown ancestry, including its origin. Distinct from the current run budget.

retry_attempt_limit.description: Lifetime limit for this same content-unknown ancestry, independent of attempt_limit for the current run.

minutes_outcome_unknown_details.description: Typed ensemble unknown-call recovery state. target identifies the current node; origin is recovered from the blocked attempt and may belong to an older run. attempts_used/attempt_limit are the current run budget; retry_attempts_used/retry_attempt_limit are the separate lifetime budget for this same content-unknown ancestry. The latest attempt can be a known failure while an earlier unknown barrier remains unresolved. Full current config and the exact target/blocked receipt must be rechecked before consuming one minutes_retry confirmation. At the lifetime limit, reject before proof consumption, run reservation or send and preserve the barrier. Do not infer service-side processing or billing stopped.
